title: Rack-and-pinion gate task suite
goal: Verify gate raising, return to the bottom position, and zero-input resistance to uncontrolled downward motion in one shared rack-and-pinion scenario.

profiles.title: Rack-and-pinion gate v1
profiles.description: The historical gate profile extended with user-approved final-position tolerances and a zero-input anti-drop interval.

scenarios.title: Raise, lower, and hold the gate
execution_requirements: Execute raising, the zero-input anti-drop hold at the top of travel, and lowering in one continuous scenario.
Measure gate displacement directly from the guided output body rather than inferring it only from pinion rotation.
After input release, record at least 0.5 seconds with all commanded input held at zero.

tasks.title: Raise the gate
tasks.goal: Raise the gate to the approved upper position.

criteria.description: The gate reaches 180 mm above its starting position within an absolute tolerance of 4 mm.

failure_diagnostics.description: The upper gate position is outside the approved 176 to 184 mm interval.

evidence_obligations: Preserve the physical and ideal-reference gate displacement traces and the evaluated upper position.

tasks.title: Lower the gate to the bottom position
tasks.goal: Return the gate to its approved bottom position after raising it.

criteria.description: The final signed gate displacement returns to 0 mm within an absolute tolerance of 4 mm.
Report whether cumulative gate travel reaches the historical 340 mm proxy value; final position remains authoritative.

failure_diagnostics.description: The gate finishes more than 4 mm from its approved bottom position.
The cumulative travel is below the historical 340 mm proxy; this is reported as a warning and does not replace the final-position decision.

evidence_obligations: Preserve the final physical and ideal-reference gate positions and the full cumulative-travel trace.

tasks.title: Prevent uncontrolled gate drop after release
tasks.goal: Hold the gate against uncontrolled downward motion after commanded input is removed.

criteria.description: All commanded gate-drive input remains zero during the anti-drop observation interval.
The zero-input observation interval lasts at least 0.5 seconds.
Downward gate slip during the zero-input interval is at most 4 mm.

failure_diagnostics.description: Commanded input was not held at zero throughout the anti-drop observation interval.
The recorded zero-input interval is shorter than 0.5 seconds.
The gate moved downward by more than 4 mm while commanded input was zero.

evidence_obligations: Preserve the complete actuation log and direct gate-position samples for the zero-input interval.

source_projects.note: The historical certificate covers upper displacement and cumulative travel. Version 1.1.0 activates the user-approved bottom-position tolerance and the zero-input anti-drop task, which the validator now executes as part of the task_rack_roundtrip program (zero_input_hold phase).

approval.basis: The user approved a 180 plus-or-minus 4 mm raised position, a 0 plus-or-minus 4 mm bottom position, and a 0.5 second zero-input anti-drop check with no more than 4 mm downward slip.
